name: Visual Novel Workshop
detailed_description:
Imagine, Write, Bring It to Life.

Visual Novel Workshop is designed for anyone who wants to tell their story on their own terms. With no coding required and a fully visual interface, this powerful tool allows writers, artists, and creatives to build their own visual novels from the ground up.

Whether you're crafting a simple narrative or a complex, branching interactive experience, Visual Novel Workshop gives you everything you need to bring your vision to life.

KEY FEATURES

🎨 NO CODING REQUIRED
Create your game with an intuitive drag-and-drop interface. Ideal for beginners and professionals alike.

🗺️ CHOICE-BASED STORYTELLING
Branch your story based on player choices. Add or hide scenes, dialogues, and visuals depending on selected conditions to create deeply interactive experiences.

🌍 MULTI-LANGUAGE SUPPORT WITH ONE-CLICK TRANSLATION
Build games in up to 24 different languages! Write your story in your native language and instantly translate it into 24 others with a single click.

📐 FLEXIBLE VISUAL LAYOUT OPTIONS
Draw your story scenes in full screen, custom sizes, or classic visual novel formats. Visual Novel Workshop supports any resolution.

🖌️ CUSTOMIZABLE UI
Personalize every aspect of your user interface — from button colors and sizes to font styles and animated text effects. Your story, your style.

🔊 AUDIO & VISUAL ENRICHMENT
Easily add sound effects, music, and images to elevate the emotional impact of your story.

🚀 PyGame and Unity Export Support
You can easily export your game to either the PyGame or Unity game engines. The export process is quick and user-friendly.

PyGame: PyGame is a free and open-source Python library. No additional requirements are needed — simply create your game with a single click. Visual Novel Workshop integrates seamlessly with PyGame, allowing you to quickly develop your game and get started right away.

Unity: To use your game in the Unity engine, you'll need to download the free Visual Novel Workshop asset. The installation process is straightforward with provided instructions. If you're not using Unity, you can choose PyGame instead.
